_meta.description: California ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs) -> [lat, lon] internal point (WGS84 decimal degrees, rounded to 4 dp). Every other key is a 5-digit ZCTA; skip this '_meta' key when iterating.
_meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Gazetteer Files, ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (national file 2024_Gaz_zcta_national.txt), columns GEOID, INTPTLAT, INTPTLONG
_meta.note: California filtered as ZCTAs 90000-96199 (USPS 900-961 prefix range for CA; all filtered points verified to fall inside a lat 32-42.1 / lon -124.6 to -114 box). ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP codes; PO-box-only and some single-business ZIPs have no ZCTA, so look up the nearest ZCTA or fall back to the city. Internal points are Census 'internal point' coordinates (inside the polygon), not population-weighted centroids.
